# GSAP

Pinned GSAP 3.13.0 distribution files (trailing whitespace normalized) from:

- https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/gsap@3.13.0/dist/gsap.min.js
- https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/gsap@3.13.0/dist/ScrollTrigger.min.js (`ScrollTrigger-3.13.0.min.js`, used only by the public landing page)

Copyright and license notice are preserved in each distribution header.
License: https://gsap.com/standard-license/ (GSAP, including its plugins, is free to use).

Used only as progressive motion enhancement. No scores or result bands are calculated by this library or by the page JavaScript.
